description: Source code for KafkaDelegationTokenProvider class in Spark Kafka connector, responsible for obtaining and managing delegation tokens for Kafka clusters with specific security protocols.

classes.name: KafkaDelegationTokenProvider
classes.description: A class that provides delegation tokens for Kafka clusters with specific security protocols, extending HadoopDelegationTokenProvider and Logging.

methods.name: serviceName
methods.description: Returns the service name, which is 'kafka'.

methods.name: obtainDelegationTokens
methods.description: Obtains delegation tokens for Kafka clusters based on configuration, updating credentials and returning the next renewal date.

methods.name: delegationTokensRequired
methods.description: Checks if delegation tokens are required for given Spark and Hadoop configurations.

methods.name: delegationTokensRequired (private)
methods.description: Determines if delegation tokens are required based on the cluster configuration security protocol.
